_readme: ROUTERS golden sample (operator order 5 Oct 2026: the router category only, until every Cisco router is shop_ready).
HAND-VERIFIED expected values, the gate's own set (src/pipeline/gate-extract.ts): a row is one (sku, field) expectation,
and ruling B (30 Sep 2026) commits a router document family only with >= 5 of them for SKUs its own sheets list.
How each row was verified: the RAW is the cell as the cached page prints it, read through the extractor's own grid reader
(cisco_specs_deep._rows, table/row/column given in `at`), and the VALUE is computed by hand from that raw under the
dictionary's unit (router_throughput Gbit/s: '500 Mbps' -> 0.5; rack_units HE; power_max W from a '(watts)' label).
Nothing here was copied from an extractor or mapper output and blessed -- that would pass however wrong the pipeline is.
The ISR 4000 weights are here since the weight ruling of 5 Oct ~23:10 (src/core/weightConfig.ts): the base PID's
no-module row with the supply it ships with, the DC row for the distinct DC PID. NOT here: its humidity (operating and
non-operating rows share the label 'Relative humidity'); its altitude now reads the rest-of-world row only.
